title: Integer - currency is a currency

source.quote: In the following table, the row header is the minuend (left side) and the column header is the subtrahend (right side).
source.supports: the Subtraction (-) table of result types: INTEGER - CURRENCY is CURRENCY

source.quote: When a decimal is involved, the result is decimal. Otherwise, when a currency is involved then the result is currency. The result is integer only when both operands are also integers.
Returns the value as a currency data type
source.supports: CURRENCY ( x ) is a currency (fixed decimal) value

derivation: 5 is an integer and CURRENCY ( 1.5 ) a currency. INTEGER - CURRENCY is CURRENCY: 5 - 1.5 = 3.5.
